selected_evidence.requirement: Rootless Node.js container and service named node-hello
selected_evidence.summary: Podman reports rootless=true; node-hello.service is active; the node-hello container is running `node /app/server.js`; its host-side process owner is nodeapp.

selected_evidence.requirement: Return exactly Hello, world! from / on TCP 8080
selected_evidence.summary: Before and after reboot, a request to $NODE_IP:8080/ matched the exact expected 13 bytes. The listener is on 0.0.0.0:8080 and firewalld permits the port persistently.
nodeapp has /usr/sbin/nologin, lingering is enabled, and the generated node-hello service is linked into the user default target and active after reboot.

Healthy baseline used boot ID f9031a39-89d7-426a-ae19-a60bfdcd23e1; the reboot was acknowledged; node1 returned with boot ID 7f3aeb40-ad09-4fe4-b533-5cee2eeeae80; system, service, container, firewall, and exact HTTP response all recovered.
